description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the ResetPasswordDao component within the OrangeHRM system. It contains setup procedures and test methods to verify reset password request saving, retrieval by reset code, and updating password validity.

classes.name: ResetPasswordDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the ResetPasswordDao's functionality related to password reset requests in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, sets up the ResetPasswordDao, resets password service, loads test fixture data, and creates a test kernel with mock services.

methods.name: testSaveResetPassword
methods.description: Tests that a ResetPasswordRequest can be saved correctly and that the saved data matches expected email and reset code.

methods.name: testGetResetPasswordLogByResetCode
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of a reset password log entry using a specific reset code.

methods.name: testUpdateResetPasswordValid
methods.description: Checks that the reset password validity can be updated successfully for a given email.
